description: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers of a model, with a threshold set to 1e-2. The x-axis represents the layer index, ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 5, and is labeled "Layer". The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2, and is labeled "Sparsity Ratio". Three lines are plotted: the blue dashed line with circular markers, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", starts near 0.2 at layer 0 and remains low, fluctuating slightly around 0.05 up to layer 20. The orange dotted line with triangular markers, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", begins near 1.0 at layer 0, decreases sharply to approximately 0.3 by layer 10, then fluctuates between approximately 0.2 and 0.4 through layer 20. The green dashed line with square markers, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33", also begins near 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.3 by layer 10, then fluctuates between approximately 0.1 and 0.2 through layer 20.
